But in S=Q[y_1,y_2,y_3] with weighted degrees deg(y_i)=i, the homogeneous degree-1 subspace is one-dimensional, spanned by y_1. Hence any homogeneous u_1,u_2 of degree 1 are proportional. If u_1=0 then the sequence is not regular; if u_1!=0 then u_2 lies in (u_1), so its image in S/(u_1) is 0, which is not a non-zero-divisor in the nonzero ring S/(u_1). Therefore no regular sequence u_1,u_2,u_3 with degrees 1,1,6 exists.
